contract: The old Thread owner accepts only completed scientific ContextPacket/GroundedResponse turns. Native advisory conversation needs an additive context/result contract and failed/cancelled delivery states. Whole raw turn plus terminal is not valid copilot-turn JSON: a separate registered result extension now preserves that meaning. Unknown provider resource usage must remain null, not manufactured zero. The second failure is strictRequired compilation of the new terminal-result conditional, not a missing provider or database.
architecture: Private immutable turn/terminal bytes remain content extensions, while canonical ProjectThread, InteractionRun and bounded Work own identity, authority and outcomes. Existing repositories now participate in one explicit outer transaction, retaining their validations rather than copying owner SQL. Historical import must identify actual adoption Work and must not reconstruct original grants or model execution. Metadata readers need version dispatch and must not force native contexts into scientific snapshots.
dependencies: New Thread, ThreadView, terminal Result and unavailable-resource OutputManifest schemas need accepted fixtures and strict validator compilation before persistence tests. Work and Run owner reads must share the outer transaction. Native history must bind exact definition, input/result Artifacts, actor, grant and applicable lineage; pagination and current-authorized disclosure remain required before W03 can close. The existing eligible advisory model adapter is unchanged; no new provider eligibility is inferred from storage tests.
environment: A separate disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 instance successfully applied all 66 immutable forward migrations. It is independent of the running inspection previews and uses repository-controlled fixture credentials. The first test failure was a non-HTTPS provider label in an HTTPS allowlist contract. The replacement records an allowed managed-service destination; it does not claim inspection or enforcement of the provider's internal network routing, which remains unavailable.
verification: The six PostgreSQL functions share a setup boundary. One failed input schema produced six dependent failures; the second run passed actor/Project isolation but failed terminal schema compilation. TypeScript compilation cannot compile AJV schemas, and tests over old fixtures do not cover newly registered roots. No W03 execution or critical pass has been recorded and no item has been closed. Positive storage recovery, adversarial owner substitution, atomic rollback, immutable history import, pagination and real browser restoration still need separate evidence.
changed_remedy: Stop PostgreSQL retries. Add valid and adverse accepted fixtures for every new contract and run the full strict contract suite first; repair terminal conditional schemas without weakening AJV. Audit and repair all affected normal readers before persistence execution. Then test canonical storage with real PostgreSQL, add deliberate rollback/replay/cross-owner attacks as a distinct critical pass, and capture a fresh browser against the actual production persistence only after those owner tests pass. Keep the roadmap and executable ledger synchronized and leave W03 open until every acceptance criterion has evidence.
